response: Once more, we witness the predictable fallout from discarding personal responsibility and the traditional standards of integrity that once anchored our societies. South African actress Terry Pheto has been drawn back into controversy after new details emerged linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving R20.56 million from the National Lotteries Commission in an SIU probe. These revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. This is exactly what happens when we abandon those foundations in favor of unaccountable modern institutions that erode our social order and national values.
